notes: Self-declared as a racing game, and racing against computer opponents is the arcade circuit case, so it takes Circuit Racing on route-circuit: a starting grid wide enough for the player and the AI field to launch side by side, guardrails that actually stop a car, and lap detection at the line. The author explicitly refused further questions, so I decided the rest from the genre: a closed lap circuit rather than a point-to-point sprint because a field of AI racers is normally run over laps, no stated theme so the track is dressed generically, and trigger-finish added on top of the preset because the run needs a terminal round-ending zone at the line and lap detection alone does not provide one. P6 is the genre-wide route and stays, since the track has to read as one continuous followable circuit in plan view.
